meta.description: Frequently asked questions about AIBD airport transfers, fixed prices, the airport pickup process, online booking and our 24/7 private driver service.

hero.subtitle: Find quick answers to your questions about our transport services in Senegal

cta.subtitle: Our team is here to help. Get in touch with us directly!

schemaFaqs.question: How do I book a transfer?
schemaFaqs.answer: It's very simple! Head to our booking page, fill in the form with your flight details and personal information. You'll receive an email confirmation with your driver's details.

schemaFaqs.question: What are your rates?
schemaFaqs.answer: Our rates vary depending on the destination. For Dakar - AIBD or AIBD - Dakar, our rates start at 25,000 FCFA. For any other destination, contact us for a personalized quote.

schemaFaqs.question: What types of vehicles do you offer?
schemaFaqs.answer: We offer a modern fleet of vehicles: sedans, SUVs and air-conditioned minibuses. All our vehicles are perfectly maintained and equipped for your comfort.

schemaFaqs.question: How will I be found at the airport?
schemaFaqs.answer: Your driver will be waiting for you in the arrivals hall with a sign bearing your name. He will also contact you by phone if necessary. We will send you his contact details before your arrival.

questions.question: How do I book a transfer?
questions.answer: It's very simple! Head to our booking page, fill in the form with your flight details and personal information. You'll receive an email confirmation with your driver's details.

questions.question: What are your rates?
questions.answer: Our rates vary depending on the destination. For Dakar - AIBD or AIBD - Dakar, our rates start at 25,000 FCFA. For any other destination, contact us for a personalized quote.

questions.question: Are there any hidden fees?
questions.answer: No, our rates are fully transparent. The price shown includes transport, luggage assistance and 30 minutes of free waiting time. Only tolls and parking may be added depending on the route.

questions.question: Can I cancel my booking?
questions.answer: Yes, you can cancel up to 2 hours before the scheduled time free of charge. For last-minute cancellations, fees may apply.

questions.question: What types of vehicles do you offer?
questions.answer: We offer a modern fleet of vehicles: sedans, SUVs and air-conditioned minibuses. All our vehicles are perfectly maintained and equipped for your comfort.

questions.question: Are your drivers professional?
questions.answer: Absolutely! All our drivers are certified, experienced and know the roads of Senegal inside out.

questions.question: Do you offer 24/7 service?
questions.answer: Yes, we are available 24/7 for all your airport transfers and private trips. Our drivers are always ready to serve you.

questions.question: What happens if my flight is delayed?
questions.answer: No problem! We monitor flights in real time. Your driver will wait free of charge for up to 1 hour after the scheduled arrival time. Beyond that, waiting fees may apply.

questions.question: How will I be found at the airport?
questions.answer: Your driver will be waiting for you in the arrivals hall with a sign bearing your name. He will also contact you by phone if necessary. We will send you his contact details before your arrival.

questions.question: How far in advance should I book before my flight?
questions.answer: We recommend booking at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. However, we do accept last-minute bookings subject to availability.

questions.question: Can I book a round trip?
questions.answer: Of course! We offer round-trip packages with preferential rates. Contact us to find out about our special offers.

questions.question: What happens if I miss my flight?
questions.answer: If you miss your flight, contact us immediately. We will adjust your booking to match your new flight at no extra cost.

questions.question: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.answer: We accept cash (FCFA), bank card, bank transfer and mobile money (Orange Money, Free Money). Payment is usually made at the end of the service.

questions.question: Can I pay in advance?
questions.answer: Yes, you can pay in advance by bank transfer or mobile money. This secures your booking and may qualify you for preferential rates.

questions.question: Do you issue invoices?
questions.answer: Yes, we issue professional invoices for all our services. They're perfect for your business travel expense reports.

questions.question: Do you offer chauffeur hire services?
questions.answer: Yes! We offer chauffeur hire services for set durations. Ideal for events, sightseeing tours or business trips.

questions.question: Do you organize sightseeing tours?
questions.answer: Absolutely! Our driver-guides will help you discover Dakar and its surroundings. We offer custom itineraries based on your interests.

questions.question: Can I book for a group?
questions.answer: Yes, we have vehicles suited to groups (up to 8 people). Contact us to arrange transport for your team or group of friends.
